title: HollyShorts Dubai 2025
deck: A complete identity for the first HollyShorts in Dubai.
lede: The first HollyShorts in Dubai needed a whole identity at once. It came from one image, the Burj Khalifa in watercolor under a pink and blue sky.
challenge: The inaugural HollyShorts Dubai International Film Festival took place in 2025. As a first edition, everything had to be made new: the complete visual identity and all festival creative, from the key art to the production design across the venue.
work: Watercolor turns the tallest building in the world into something closer to a postcard: a welcome rather than a monument. The key art sets the Burj Khalifa under a pink and blue sky, with the HollyShorts laurel, so the new festival is unmistakably in Dubai and unmistakably HollyShorts.

The same art carries the welcome signage, the main ballroom sign, the step-and-repeat and the on-screen welcome. It also runs through the badges, award show graphics such as Best of the Fest and Best International, the flyer and the official selection graphics.
credits: Dalton Corr: art direction, design, key art
press: Variety covered the inaugural HollyShorts Dubai.
League of Filmmakers: the 2025 festival guide and the Dubai poster reveal.
